patterns.note: Full-width sections with content often presented in a two-column layout, pairing large text blocks with accompanying imagery or lists.
Extreme typographic scale contrast, featuring massive, wide sans-serif headings that dominate sections, paired with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and subtle uppercase labels.
A high-contrast dark mode aesthetic, primarily using a deep charcoal background with light text, interspersed with light beige sections featuring dark text, accented by a subtle warm orange-brown.

Large section titles ('Services', 'Expertise') stick to the top of the viewport as their associated content scrolls underneath, then un-stick to reveal the next section. The initial full-screen hero with oversized text scrolls away to reveal the main page content.
Each major content block is introduced by an extremely large, bold typographic heading that serves as a visual anchor and navigational cue.

technique_notes: The initial hero is a full-viewport section with a background image and overlaid, oversized text. As the user scrolls, the hero text fades or scrolls out, and the background image scrolls up, revealing the main page content. The site header transitions from transparent to a solid dark background.

Major section titles are implemented as sticky elements. They are positioned to remain fixed at the top of the viewport for the duration that their corresponding content is visible, then release and scroll away to allow the next section title to take their place.
Content blocks and images within sections are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the user's viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, wide, bold sans-serif headings (up to 6x body text) with smaller, standard sans-serif body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, particularly around large headings and between main sections, with balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and dramatic use of typography, especially the extremely oversized, wide sans-serif section titles that stick to the viewport, creating a strong visual hierarchy and guiding the user through the content flow in a memorable way.
